boundary: Hypothetical evidence contexts and model-authored counterfactual contrasts. Rewrites disambiguate the target distinction only; not global unambiguity labels. Conditional answers are scenario witnesses, not actual-world findings.

cases.question: Did Atlas meet its liquidity floor?
cases.context: The issuer's parent has 12m cash, the subsidiary has 7m cash; each is measured against a 10m floor.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the Atlas parent meet its 10m cash floor?
Did the Atlas operating subsidiary meet its 10m cash floor?

cases.question: Is the East exchange below its outage limit?
cases.context: The East metro exchange had 2 outage hours; the identically named rural exchange had 9. Limit: 5 hours.

alternatives.rewrite: Is the East metro exchange below five outage hours?
Is the East rural exchange below five outage hours?

cases.question: Did profit exceed 20 million?
cases.context: Operating profit is 23m; net income is 17m.

alternatives.rewrite: Did operating profit exceed 20 million?
Did net income exceed 20 million?

cases.question: Did uptime reach 99.9%?
cases.context: Process uptime is 99.95%; successful-request availability is 99.7%.

alternatives.rewrite: Did process uptime reach 99.9%?
Did successful-request availability reach 99.9%?

cases.question: Was the restoration rate above 90% of 100 tickets?
cases.context: 96 tickets were marked closed, but only 84 had verified service restoration; the denominator is fixed at 100.

alternatives.rewrite: Were more than 90 of the 100 tickets marked closed?
Were more than 90 of the 100 tickets verified restored?

cases.question: Did the yield exceed 95% of the 200 inspected pieces?
cases.context: 196 pieces passed eventually; 186 passed without rework. Both use 200 inspected pieces.

alternatives.rewrite: Did eventual acceptance exceed 95% of 200 pieces?
Did acceptance without rework exceed 95% of 200 pieces?

cases.question: Did the graduation rate exceed 80%?
cases.context: 72 students graduated; 80 remained enrolled at the end; 100 originally entered. The same 72 graduates are used for either rate.

alternatives.rewrite: Did 72 graduates exceed 80% of the 80 students retained?
Did 72 graduates exceed 80% of the original 100 entrants?

cases.question: Did the treatment completion rate reach 75%?
cases.context: 60 participants completed treatment; 70 started treatment and 100 were assigned treatment.

alternatives.rewrite: Did completion among the 70 starters reach 75%?
Did completion among all 100 assigned participants reach 75%?

cases.question: Was sales growth positive in the annual report?
cases.context: Calendar-year sales rose from 100 to 108; the fiscal-year period ending September fell from 100 to 94.

alternatives.rewrite: Was calendar-year sales growth positive?
Was sales growth positive for the fiscal year ending September?

cases.question: Did monthly output exceed 400 MWh?
cases.context: The reporting date is 15 June; May completed at 450 MWh and June month-to-date totals 220 MWh.

alternatives.rewrite: Did output in the last completed calendar month, May, exceed 400 MWh?
Did June month-to-date output exceed 400 MWh?

cases.question: Was the median delivery time below 48 hours?
cases.context: For domestic orders the median is 36 hours; the median across every domestic and international order is 60 hours.

alternatives.rewrite: Was the domestic-order median below 48 hours?
Was the median across all orders below 48 hours?

cases.question: Did the trial's mean score improve?
cases.context: The mean change among completers is +5 points; the supplied intention-to-treat estimate is -1 point.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the completer-population mean score improve?
Did the intention-to-treat population mean score improve?

cases.question: Did churn in the capital region fall below 2%?
cases.context: The capital municipality had 1.5% churn; the wider metropolitan region had 2.8%.

alternatives.rewrite: Did churn within the capital municipality fall below 2%?
Did churn across the wider capital metropolitan region fall below 2%?

cases.question: Does the river corridor meet the flood clearance requirement?
cases.context: The upstream project segment has 1.2m clearance; the downstream segment has 0.7m. Required minimum: 1m.

alternatives.rewrite: Does the upstream project segment meet the 1m clearance requirement?
Does the downstream project segment meet the 1m clearance requirement?

cases.question: Is the beam deflection below 2?
cases.context: Deflection is 12 millimetres; the threshold's unit was omitted.

alternatives.rewrite: Is the beam deflection below 2 centimetres?
Is the beam deflection below 2 millimetres?

cases.question: Did the storage system deliver more than 4?
cases.context: Delivered energy is 4500 kWh; the threshold's energy unit is unspecified.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the storage system deliver more than 4 MWh?
Did the storage system deliver more than 4 GWh?

cases.question: Did assets exceed 250 in the report?
cases.context: Assets are 300,000 USD; the comparison amount may be in thousands or millions of USD.

alternatives.rewrite: Did assets exceed 250 thousand USD?
Did assets exceed 250 million USD?

cases.question: Did monthly output exceed 6 in the summary table?
cases.context: Actual output is 8500 identical units; the table header's multiplier was omitted.

alternatives.rewrite: Did monthly output exceed 6 thousand units?
Did monthly output exceed 6 ten-thousand units?

cases.question: Was the revenue change greater than 5 million?
cases.context: Revenue fell from 100m to 92m.

alternatives.rewrite: Was the magnitude of the revenue change greater than 5 million?
Was the signed current-minus-prior revenue change greater than 5 million?

cases.question: Was the displacement more than 3 mm?
cases.context: The signed vertical displacement from datum is -5 mm (downwards).

alternatives.rewrite: Was the absolute vertical displacement more than 3 mm?
Was signed upward displacement more than 3 mm?

cases.question: Did revenue change by more than 10?
cases.context: Revenue increased from 200 to 215 units; threshold 10 has no stated unit.

alternatives.rewrite: Did revenue increase by more than 10 revenue units?
Did revenue increase by more than 10 percent relative to the prior value?

cases.question: Did the average score improve by over 5?
cases.context: A score on a 100-point scale rose from 40 to 44.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the average score improve by over 5 percent relative to its old value?
Did the average score improve by over 5 score points?

cases.question: Did the failure rate increase by more than 10 percent?
cases.context: Failure rate rose from 20% to 25%; a colloquial report uses percent for both relative change and points.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the failure rate increase by more than 10 percent relative to the previous rate?
Did the failure rate increase by more than 10 percentage points?

cases.question: Did participation increase by at least 5 percent?
cases.context: Participation rose from 50% to 53%. The reporting convention is unclear.

alternatives.rewrite: Did participation increase by at least 5 percent relative to baseline?
Did participation increase by at least 5 percentage points?

cases.question: Was the average defect rate under 10% across plants?
cases.context: Plant A: 1 defect in 100 items. Plant B: 9 defects in 20 items.

alternatives.rewrite: Was the item-weighted defect rate under 10% across both plants?
Was the unweighted average of plant defect rates under 10%?

cases.question: Was average API latency below 100 ms across regions?
cases.context: Region A has 900 requests averaging 50 ms; region B has 100 requests averaging 200 ms.

alternatives.rewrite: Was request-weighted mean latency below 100 ms?
Was the equal-region mean of regional latencies below 100 ms?

cases.question: Did not all candidates pass?
cases.context: Three candidates passed and one failed.

alternatives.rewrite: Is it false that all four candidates passed?
Is it true that all four candidates did not pass (none passed)?

cases.question: Did the backup not run on Monday and Tuesday?
cases.context: The backup ran Monday but did not run Tuesday.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the backup fail to run on at least one of Monday and Tuesday?
Did the backup fail to run on both Monday and Tuesday?

cases.question: Did every site use a shared spare router?
cases.context: Site A used spare R1; site B used spare R2. Both used a spare, but no spare was used at both sites.

alternatives.rewrite: Did each site use some spare router?
Was there one spare router used by every site?

cases.question: Can all orders be served by a single truck?
cases.context: Each order fits independently on one truck; all orders together weigh 12 tonnes and truck capacity is 8 tonnes.

alternatives.rewrite: Can every order be served individually by one truck trip?
Can all orders together be served by the same single truck trip?

cases.question: If demand peaks, are reserves and imports adequate?
cases.context: Peak reserves: adequate; peak imports: inadequate. Outside peak, both are adequate.

alternatives.rewrite: During peak demand, are both reserves and imports adequate?
During peak demand are reserves adequate, with imports assessed outside peak?
alternatives.witness: Peak reserves and off-peak imports are adequate

cases.question: Are the alarm and valve shutdown required when pressure rises?
cases.context: At high pressure an alarm is required but valve shutdown is required only if temperature is also high. Current temperature is normal.

alternatives.rewrite: With pressure high and temperature normal, are both alarm and shutdown required?
With pressure high, is the alarm required, and is shutdown required only when temperature is also high?

cases.question: Did costs fall by at least 10%?
cases.context: Current costs 90; last year's costs 95; original budget 110.

alternatives.rewrite: Did costs fall by at least 10% relative to the original budget?
Did costs fall by at least 10% relative to last year's actual costs?

cases.question: Did the new design reduce excavation by at least 20%?
cases.context: New design 800 m3; approved design 1000 m3; latest revision 900 m3.

alternatives.rewrite: Did excavation fall by at least 20% versus the original approved design?
Did excavation fall by at least 20% versus the latest revision?

cases.question: Did temperature exceed 25 degrees Celsius?
cases.context: The raw sensor reading is 26 C; a documented calibration subtracts 2 C.

alternatives.rewrite: Did the raw sensor reading exceed 25 degrees Celsius?
Did the calibrated sensor estimate exceed 25 degrees Celsius?

cases.question: Did wages grow in real terms?
cases.context: Nominal wage growth is 5%; inflation measured by national CPI is 3%; the local cost-of-living index rose 8%.

alternatives.rewrite: Did wages grow after adjusting by the national CPI?
Did wages grow after adjusting by the local cost-of-living index?

cases.question: Should the service handle 1000 requests per second?
cases.context: The capacity specification requires 1000 requests/s; only a 700 requests/s load test is documented.

alternatives.rewrite: Does the specification require support for 1000 requests per second?
Has the service demonstrated support for 1000 requests per second?
alternatives.witness: 700 requests/s is the only tested level

cases.question: Can the turbine supply 5 MW?
cases.context: Nameplate capacity is 5 MW; current weather and operating conditions are unknown.

alternatives.rewrite: Is the turbine rated to supply 5 MW under specified conditions?
Can the turbine supply 5 MW under current operating conditions?
alternatives.witness: No current operating conditions are supplied

cases.question: Did the new tariff lead to higher churn?
cases.context: Churn rose after the tariff change from 1% to 2%; a concurrent competitor launch occurred and no causal identification study is supplied.

alternatives.rewrite: Did churn rise after the new tariff was introduced?
Did the new tariff independently cause the increase in churn?
alternatives.witness: No design isolates tariff from competitor launch

cases.question: Did the intervention improve attendance?
cases.context: Attendance increased from 60% to 75% among participants; no untreated comparison or adjustment for selection is supplied.

alternatives.rewrite: Did attendance increase among intervention participants?
Did the intervention cause the attendance increase relative to its counterfactual?
